channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Danjiraha Türkiye Ferhat Alkan oo kulan la qaatay Madaxweynihii hore Maxamed Cabdullaahi Farmaajo
item.description: Danjiraha Türkiye u fadhiya Soomaaliya, Ferhat Alkan, ayaa kulan isbarasho ah la yeeshay Madaxweynihii 9-aad ee Soomaaliya, Maxamed Cabdullaahi Maxamed Farmaajo. Labada dhinac waxay ka wada hadleen xaaladda Soomaaliya, xiriirka Türkiye iyo Soomaaliya iyo arrimaha gobolka iyo caalamka, sida lagu sheegay war ka soo baxay Safaaradda Türkiye.

item.title: Kenya: Ronald Karauri oo ku biiray UDA si uu ula tartamo Sakaja xilka guddoomiyaha Nairobi
item.description: Xildhibaanka Kasarani Ronald Karauri ayaa si rasmi ah ugu biiray xisbiga talada haya ee UDA si uu ugu tartamo xilka guddoomiyaha gobolka Nairobi doorashada 2027, sida ay werisay Capital FM. Arrintan ayaa timid maalmo kadib markii Guddoomiye Johnson Sakaja uu UDA uga wareegay xisbiga ODM.

item.title: Trump oo sheegay in nacaybka Israa'iil uu ka mid ahaa sababaha Jamhuuriyiinta looga adkaaday
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa wareysi uu siiyay barnaamijka "60 Minutes" ee CBS ku sheegay in dagaalka Iran, kororka qiimaha shidaalka iyo nacayb loo qabo Israa'iil ay ka mid ahaayeen sababaha Jamhuuriyiintu uga guuldarreysteen doorashooyinka xilliga dhexe, sida ay werisay CNN.

item.title: Alisson oo sheegay in uu doonayo in uu sii joogo Liverpool
item.description: Goolhayaha Liverpool Alisson, oo heshiiskiisu dhamaanayo dhammaadka xilli ciyaareedkan, ayaa sheegay in rabitaankiisu yahay in uu sii joogo Anfield, kadib guushii 3-1 ee Axaddii ay ka gaareen Crystal Palace, sida ay werisay Sky Sports.

item.title: Uganda: Bangiga Dhexe oo heerka dulsaarka ku sii hayay 12%
item.description: Bangiga Dhexe ee Uganda ayaa heerka dulsaarka ee CBR ku sii hayay 12%, isagoo ka digay in qiimaha tamarta, hoos u dhaca shilinka iyo cimilada xun ay sare u qaadi karaan sicir bararka, sida uu sheegay Guddoomiyaha bangiga Michael Atingi-Ego. Bangiga ayaa sidoo kale ballaariyay xadka CBR oo laga dhigay 3 dhibcood oo boqolley ah.

item.title: Kenya: Ruto oo ku jees jeesay hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ee sheeganaya malaayiin cod
item.description: Madaxweyne William Ruto ayaa su'aal geliyay sheegashada Rigathi Gachagua, Kalonzo Musyoka iyo Fred Matiang'i ee ah in ay haystaan malaayiin cod, kadib kulan ay toddobaadkan ku yeesheen Nairobi oo ku saabsanaa doorashada 2027, sida ay werisay Capital FM. Ruto ayaa hadalkan ka sheegay socdaal uu ku marayay gobolka Gusii.

item.title: Giriigga: Ugu yaraan 21 muhaajiriin ah oo ku dhintay isku day ay ku doonayeen gaarista Crete
item.description: Ilaalada xeebaha Giriigga ayaa sheegtay in ugu yaraan 21 qof ay ku dhinteen isku day ay ku doonayeen in ay gaaraan jasiiradda Crete, halka in ka badan 100 qof lagu badbaadiyay hawlgallo dhowr ah oo koonfurta jasiiradda ka dhacay, sida ay werisay Al Jazeera.

item.title: Xasan Cali Khayre oo laba sarkaal ku eedeeyay dil iyo dhulboob ka dhacay xaafadda Raadeerka ee Deyniile
item.description: Ra'iisul wasaarihii hore ee Soomaaliya, Xasan Cali Khayre, ayaa bartiisa Facebook ku cambaareeyay waxa uu ugu yeeray xasuuq, dhulboob iyo barakicin ka socda xaafadda Raadeerka ee degmada Deyniile, wuxuuna eedda dusha uga tuuray laba sarkaal oo uu magacaabay. Saraakiisha iyo dowladda midkoodna weli kama jawaabin eedeymahan.

item.title: Cricket: England oo Brydon Carse u furtay dib u soo laabasho, Shoaib Bashir-na ka reebtay
item.description: England ayaa ciyaartoyga Brydon Carse ku dartay kooxda Lions, taasoo u furaysa inuu ku soo laabto Test-ka safarka Koonfur Afrika, halka 15-ka ciyaartoy ee taxanaha 3-da Test ee ka bilaabanaya Johannesburg 17-ka Diseembar uu Liam Patterson-White ku beddelay Shoaib Bashir, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Kenya: Murkomen oo ugu baaqay Sifuna inuu taageero Ruto, kuna ballanqaaday hoggaanka 2032
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Gudaha Kenya, Kipchumba Murkomen, ayaa ugu baaqay Senatarka Nairobi Edwin Sifuna inuu ka tanaasulo hamigiisa madaxweyne ee doorashada 2027 oo uu garab istaago Madaxweyne William Ruto, isagoo sheegay in bulshada Luhya ay sidaas ku heli karto hoggaanka dalka sannadka 2032, sida ay werisay Capital FM.

item.title: Pierre Kalulu oo dhaawac darteed seegi doona kulamada Faransiiska ee Nations League
item.description: Baaritaanno lagu sameeyay kadib kulankii Juventus iyo Fiorentina ayaa muujiyay in daafaca Pierre Kalulu uu dhaawac muruq ah ka gaaray lugta bidix, sidaas darteed ma ka qayb gali doono kulamada Faransiiska ee Talyaaniga iyo Turkiga, sida ay wariyeen La Gazzetta dello Sport iyo L'Équipe.

item.title: Koonfur Suudaan: Jen. Joseph Lagu waxaa lagu aasi doonaa xabaalaha Dr John Garang ee Juba
item.description: Guddiga qabanqaabada aaska qaran ee Jeneraal Joseph Lagu Yanga, hoggaamiyihii dhaqdhaqaaqa Anyanya One, ayaa u sheegay Eye Radio in lagu aasi doono gudaha xabaalaha Dr John Garang ee magaalada Juba, kadib markii Madaxweyne Salva Kiir go'aamiyay in loo sameeyo aas qaran.

item.title: Halyeeyga judo-da Teddy Riner oo u tartamaya madaxweynaha Faransiiska 2027
item.description: Teddy Riner, oo 5 jeer ku guuleystay bilad dahab ah oo Olombikada ah, ayaa Isniintii ku dhawaaqay inuu u tartami doono doorashada madaxweynaha Faransiiska ee sannadka 2027, sida ay werisay France 24.

item.title: Trump: "Waan ku guuleysanay Iran", iyadoo ciidamada Mareykanku weerar ku qaadeen jasiiradda Qeshm
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Axaddii sheegay in Mareykanku "ku guuleystay" dagaalka Iran, dagaal cusubna uusan u badneyn haddii Tehran heshiis la gasho, iyadoo ciidamada Mareykanku duqeeyeen jasiiradda Qeshm ee Marinka Hormuz, sida ay werisay Euronews.

item.title: Uganda: Injineerka sare ee CAA iyo 10 kale oo maxkamad la keenay kadib burburinta garoonka Entebbe
item.description: 11 sarkaal oo ka tirsan Hay'adda Duulista Rayidka ee Uganda, oo uu ku jiro injineerka sare Herbert Ngobi, ayaa Isniintii la horkeenay Maxkamadda Sare ee Entebbe iyagoo lagu eedeeyay dayacaad shaqo oo la xiriirta burburinta qalabka garoonka diyaaradaha oo qiimihiisu yahay Shs3.7 bilyan, sida ay werisay Nile Post.

item.title: Golf: Blades Brown oo 19 jir ah noqday guuleystaha ugu da'da yar PGA Tour muddo 95 sano ah
item.description: Ciyaaryahanka golf-ka Mareykanka Blades Brown oo 19 jir ah ayaa ku guuleystay tartanka World Wide Technology Championship ee Mexico, kadib markii uu Ben James kaga adkaaday godka labaad ee kala-saarka, isagoo noqday guuleystaha ugu da'da yar PGA Tour muddo 95 sano ah, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Iran: Kormeerayaasha IAEA ayaa dhowaan booqday xarunta nukliyeerka ee Bushehr
item.description: Afhayeenka Wasaaradda Arrimaha Dibadda Iran Esmaeil Baghaei ayaa sheegay in kormeerayaasha Hay'adda Tamarta Nukliyeerka Adduunka (IAEA) ay dhowaan booqdeen warshadda korontada nukliyeerka ee Bushehr, isagoo ku tilmaamay caddayn in iskaashiga hay'addu uu socdo, sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Bundesliga: Bayer Leverkusen oo 2-1 ku garaacday 1. FC Köln
item.description: Bayer Leverkusen ayaa 2-1 ku garaacday 1. FC Köln kulankii Bundesliga (wareegga 9aad) ee 8 Nofembar, garoonka RheinEnergieStadion.

item.title: Bundesliga: Hoffenheim oo 2-1 ku garaacday Schalke 04
item.description: Hoffenheim ayaa 2-1 ku garaacday Schalke 04 kulankii Bundesliga (wareegga 9aad) ee 8 Nofembar, garoonka SNP Arena.

item.title: Bundesliga: SC Freiburg oo 2-0 ku garaacday Union Berlin
item.description: SC Freiburg ayaa 2-0 ku garaacday Union Berlin kulankii Bundesliga (wareegga 9aad) ee 8 Nofembar, garoonka Europa-Park Stadion.

item.title: Guterres: Adduunku wuxuu galay 'xilli cimilo xad-dhaaf ah'
item.description: Xoghayaha Guud ee Qaramada Midoobay Antonio Guterres ayaa Isniinta ugu baaqay hoggaamiyeyaasha ku shiraya COP31 ee Antalya inay dardargeliyaan dhimista qiiqa iyo ka guurista shidaalka, isagoo sheegay in adduunku galay 'xilli cusub oo cimilo xad-dhaaf ah', sida ay werisay Türkiye Today.

item.title: Tanzania iyo WTTC oo London ka wada hadlay soo jiidashada maalgashi dalxiis
item.description: Wasiirka Kheyraadka Dabiiciga iyo Dalxiiska Tanzania Dr Ashatu Kijaji ayaa London kula kulmay guddoomiyaha Golaha Safarka iyo Dalxiiska Adduunka (WTTC) Manfredi Lefebvre, waxayna ka wada hadleen maalgashiga dalxiiska iyo kordhinta booqdayaasha caalamiga ah, sida uu werisay wargeyska dowladda ee Daily News.

item.title: IGAD iyo Jarmalka oo Jabuuti ku yeeshay wadahadalkooda sannadlaha ah ee iskaashiga
item.description: Ururka IGAD iyo dowladda Jarmalka ayaa Isniinta xarunta IGAD ee Jabuuti ku qabtay wadahadalkooda iskaashi ee sannadlaha ah, waxayna dib u xaqiijiyeen ballanqaadkooda nabadda, adkaysiga iyo is-dhexgalka gobolka Geeska Afrika, sida uu sheegay war ka soo baxay IGAD. Wafdiga IGAD waxaa hoggaaminayay Xoghayaha Fulinta Dr Workneh Gebeyehu.

item.title: Itoobiya oo goob gaar ah ka furatay shirka COP31 ee Antalya iyadoo u diyaar garoobaysa martigelinta COP32
item.description: Wasiirka Arrimaha Dibadda Itoobiya Gedion Timothewos iyo Wasiirka Maaliyadda Fitsum Assefa ayaa shirka cimilada COP31 ee Antalya, Turkiga, ka furay goobta Itoobiya, iyadoo dalku diyaar u yahay inuu 2027 martigeliyo COP32, sida ay werisay Fana oo xiriir la leh dowladda.

item.title: Guddoomiye Wetang'ula oo xoojiyay ololaha dib-u-doorashada Ruto ee galbeedka Kenya
item.description: Guddoomiyaha Golaha Qaranka Kenya Moses Wetang'ula ayaa dadka galbeedka Kenya ugu baaqay inay taageeraan Madaxweyne William Ruto oo u taagan xilli labaad doorashada guud ee 2027, isagoo sheegay in xulafadaasi ay xoojin doonto saameynta gobolka ee dowladda, sida ay werisay KBC.

item.title: Nairobi oo la kordhiyay qaybinta biyaha, kaddib markii biyaha xarafka Ndakaini hoos u dhaceen
item.description: Shirkadda Biyaha iyo Bullaacadaha Magaalada Nairobi ayaa sheegtay in qaybinta biyaha la kordhiyay, maadaama wax-soo-saarka xarumaha Ngethu iyo Kigoro uu hoos u dhacay 35%, kaddib markii biyaha xarafka Ndakaini yaraadeen; waxaa saameyn doonta qaybo ka mid ah Kiambu, Kajiado iyo Machakos, sida ay werisay KBC.

item.title: Museveni oo jaamacadaha Uganda ugu baaqay inay mudnaanta siiyaan tababarka xirfadaha
item.description: Madaxweyne Yoweri Museveni ayaa jaamacadaha Uganda ugu baaqay inay xoogga saaraan tababarka xirfadaha gacanta si ardaydu u abuuraan shaqooyin, isagoo sheegay in shaqo-la'aantu ay tahay caqabad weyn; khudbadda waxaa jaamacadda Bugema ka akhrisay Ra'iisul Wasaare Robinah Nabbanja, sida ay werisay Nile Post.

item.title: Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania oo dammaanad amaah ah ku furay 2.1 tirilyan oo shilin
item.description: Bangiga Dhexe ee Tanzania (BoT) ayaa sheegay inuu bixiyay dammaanado amaah oo dhan 1.6 tirilyan oo shilin, kuwaas oo ganacsatada u fududeeyay amaah dhan 2.1 tirilyan oo shilin oo qaybo kala duwan oo dhaqaalaha ah, sida ay werisay Daily News oo dowladdu leedahay.

item.title: Mareykanka iyo Jasiiradaha Baasifigga oo martigelin doona Koobka Adduunka Rugby League 2030
item.description: Hay'adda maamusha Rugby League ee caalamka (IRL) ayaa go'aamisay in Koobka Adduunka ee 2030 lagu qabto Mareykanka iyo Jasiiradaha Baasifigga, iyadoo 5-ta magaalo ee martigelinaysa aan weli la shaacin, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.

item.title: Holland: Ciyaarta Vitesse iyo De Graafschap oo la joojiyay kadib markii taageerayaal xireen baska kooxdooda
item.description: Ciyaar heerka labaad ee Holland oo u dhaxaysay Vitesse Arnhem iyo De Graafschap ayaa la joojiyay kadib markii taageerayaasha De Graafschap ay ka hor istaageen baska kooxdooda in uu u ambabaxo ciyaarta, sida ay werisay BBC Sport.
